content: Ghino ekelesiya gharandeviva ya roriya letake iyake na ya variye i ghaona e ghen, Gaiyus, wou valɨghareghareŋgu emunjoru kaiwae mbe ghareŋgu vara moli e ghen.
Wou valɨghareghareŋgu, lo naŋgo e tɨne nuwaŋguiya riwana i thovuye moli na bigibigike wolaghɨye thɨ thovuye e ghen ŋgoreiye e unena bigibigike wolaghɨye e tɨne i thovuye moliwe.

Ya warari laghɨye moli kaiwan mbaŋa oghaghanda vavana thɨ mena thɨ utuŋa utunin e ghino, thɨŋa ghen mbema emunjoru u ghambugha utu emunjoru moli na ya ghareghare mbaŋake wolaghɨye u vakavakatha ŋgoreiyako.
Thembaŋa thoŋgo ya loŋwevaidiyava lo ŋgaŋga utuninji, thiye thɨ loŋgaloŋga utu emunjoru moli e ghakamwathɨ, iyake i vakathaŋgo ya warari laghɨye, na lo warariko iyako i kivwala wararike wolaghɨye.
Wou valɨghareghareŋgu, emunjoru kaiwo thovuye iya u vakavakathana, kaiwae oghaghandana iya thɨ vavaghɨliyana na thɨ vavagharena u thalavuŋgi, othembe ma u ghareghareŋgi.

Len gharethovuna weŋgi kaero thɨ utuŋa weŋgiya ekelesiya e valɨvaŋgake iyake. Gharɨgharɨ ŋgoranjiyako, thoŋgo mbowo thɨ vaghɨliyava, nuwaŋguiya u thalavuŋgi lenji loŋgaloŋga kaiwae. Vakatha ŋgoreiyana Loi i warari kaiwae.
Gharɨgharɨna iya thɨ rakarakaraŋgina thɨ kaiwo Krais kaiwae. Ma thɨ mban mun ghanjithalavu weŋgiya thiye ma raloŋweloŋweghathɨ.
Iya kaiwae ghinda ekelesiya ra thalavuŋgiya gharɨgharɨ ŋgoranjiyako, na ghinda ra tabo ghanjirathalavu utu emunjoru e kaiwoniye tɨne.
Tha u vakatha ŋgoreiye Diyotripes ko ŋgoreiye eŋge Demitriyas
Va ya roriya ekelesiya lenji leta yaŋgara, ko iyemaeŋge Diyotripes mava i goru weya iya lama utuko kaiwae amalaghɨniye mbema nuwaiya eŋge ghamberegha i mbaro.

Mbaŋa ne ya ghaona, ne ya uturaŋgiya le vakathako wolaghɨye. Amalaghɨniye i utuutuvatharɨ ghime kaiwame. Ko ma mbe ghime eŋge kaiwame, ko iyemaeŋge oghaghandako iya thɨ vavaghare vaghɨliyako ma i kula ruwoŋgi ele ŋgolo. Na tembe ŋgoreiyeva, i dageten thavala nuwanjiya thɨ kula ruwoŋgi, na i variye raŋgiyaŋgi ekelesiya wabwiko e tɨne.

Wou valɨghareghareŋgu, tha u varevare thanavu raitharɨ, ko iyemaeŋge u varevare thanavu thovuye. Thela thoŋgo i vakavakatha thanavu thovuye, iye Loi nariye. Thela thoŋgo i vakavakatha thanavu raitharɨ, iye ma i thuwathuwa na i ghareghareya Loi.

Gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye thɨ wovathovuthovuyeŋa Demitriyas. Thɨŋa iye lolo thovuye. Iye i ghambugha utu emunjoru, na iyake i vaemunjoruŋa iye lolo thovuye. Ghime tembe wo wovathovuthovuyeŋava ghathanavuko, na u ghareghare lama utuke emunjoru.
Lo renuwaŋa i ghanagha mbe thiyake valɨkaiwae ya woraŋgiya e ghen, ko iyemaeŋge ma nuwaŋguiya ya rorinjoŋa e peipa.
Lo renuwaŋake mbe nuwaŋguiya vara ya ghaona ya thuweŋge, ra yaku namoghamwanda na ra utu.
Loi le gharemalɨlɨ i yaku e gharena. Ghanuneke e valɨvaŋgake iyake thɨ mwaewo e ghen. Ghino lo mwaewo u utugiya weŋgiya wounena regha na regha e valɨvaŋgana iyena.
